title: Inoculating Loops

references.label: General microbiology laboratory manuals (ASM curriculum resources)

purpose: A thin wire or plastic loop used to transfer a small, semi-standardized amount of microbial culture between media.
safety: Sterilize a reusable wire loop by flaming until red-hot and allow it to cool before touching the culture.
Disposable plastic loops avoid the flaming step entirely and reduce aerosol-generation risk from flaming a contaminated loop.
